summary: This topic describes the two methods for assigning subjects to students: bulk assignment for general subjects to an entire class and individual assignment for optional or additional subjects to specific students.

steps.title: For General Subjects (to all students in a class)
details: Navigate to the 'Subject Class Mapping' list.
Select the mapping for the desired class.
Select the general subjects from the list.
Click 'Assign' or 'Assign by default' to assign them to all students in the class.

steps.title: For Optional/Additional Subjects (to specific students)
details: The list of students in that class will appear.
Select the specific students to whom the optional subject should be assigned.
Select the 'Optional Subject' from the dropdown.
Click 'Add' to assign the subject only to the selected students.

business_rules: General subjects are assigned to all students in a class through the 'Assign by default' option.
Optional subjects are assigned individually to selected students, not to the entire class by default.
important_notes: Ensure that subjects are correctly configured as 'General' or 'Optional' in the Subject Class Mapping before attempting to assign them to students.
